project.name: images-api
project.description: A Greenstand microservice that exposes a RESTful image resize API built with Express. It uses a layered MVC-like structure (protocol, service, and model layers) with a PostgreSQL database via Knex and Sharp for image processing.

nodes.name: Image Processing & Delivery
nodes.summary: The core business domain of the service. It fetches a remote source image, validates the requested resize parameters, applies Sharp transforms, and streams the resulting image back to the caller. Two GET endpoints expose an original-image path and a parameterized resize path.

businessRules: Resize parameters are validated with Joi before any transform runs
Params encode height/width/rotation/quality in a compact form (e.g. h=100,w=100)
When no params are supplied the original image buffer is returned unchanged
Output transforms produce a JPEG buffer streamed back to the client
crossDomainInteractions: Receives dispatched requests from the API Request Lifecycle middleware and router
Throws HttpError/Joi/Axios errors that the global error handler converts to HTTP responses

nodes.name: API Request Lifecycle
nodes.summary: The Express protocol layer that boots the service and shapes every request and response. It loads environment config, wires CORS, JSON parsing, and a content-type guard, dispatches routes through an async wrapper, and centralizes error translation.

businessRules: Non-JSON POST requests are rejected with HTTP 415 by the content-type guard
Every async route handler is wrapped so rejected promises reach the global error handler
The global error handler maps HttpError, Joi ValidationError, and Axios errors, defaulting to 500
Environment config is loaded per NODE_ENV before the app starts listening
crossDomainInteractions: Dispatches HTTP requests to the image-resize handlers
Translates errors thrown by the image and data layers into HTTP responses

nodes.name: Data Persistence
nodes.summary: A Knex/Postgres persistence scaffold for future repositories. It provides a transactional session abstraction and a generic base repository with CRUD and filtered-query helpers. The current resize flow is stateless, so this layer is groundwork rather than an active path.

businessRules: Data access runs inside a transaction session with explicit begin/commit/rollback
Filter objects are translated recursively into chained Knex where clauses
Repository failures raise HttpError carrying an HTTP status and a rollback flag
crossDomainInteractions: Repository errors surface as HttpError that the API Request Lifecycle error handler translates

nodes.name: Build & Deployment
nodes.summary: The delivery lifecycle that takes the service from commit to production. GitHub Actions lint and test the code, semantic-release versions it, Docker packages it, and Kustomize overlays promote the image tag across development, test, and production Kubernetes environments.

businessRules: Pull requests must pass ESLint and integration tests before merge
Push to main triggers a semantic-release version, Docker build/push, and dev overlay bump
Production and test promotions are manual workflow_dispatch runs gated to the Greenstand organization
Environment overlays differ only by image tag over a shared Kustomize base
crossDomainInteractions: Containerizes and deploys the running Express app defined by the API Request Lifecycle

nodes.name: Serve Resized Image
nodes.summary: Handles a parameterized image request: parses the arbitrary-depth image URL and resize params from the path, fetches the source image, validates and applies the transforms, and streams the resized JPEG back.

nodes.name: Serve Image
nodes.summary: Handles a plain image request for a given domain and image identifier: validates the request params, resizes through the service, and pipes the resulting stream back to the client.

nodes.name: Application Bootstrap
nodes.summary: Starts the microservice: loads the per-environment dotenv file, configures the log level, builds the Express app factory, and begins listening on the configured port.

nodes.name: Request Middleware Chain
nodes.summary: The per-request pipeline every call passes through: CORS and JSON parsing, a content-type guard that rejects non-JSON POSTs with 415, route dispatch via an async wrapper, and centralized error translation.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Any HTTP request to the Express app

nodes.name: Repository Data Access
nodes.summary: The transactional persistence path for future repositories: open a Knex session, build a filtered query, run a CRUD operation, and commit or roll back based on the outcome.

domainMeta.entryPoint: BaseRepository method call within a Session

nodes.name: Pull Request CI
nodes.summary: Validates every pull request to main: installs dependencies, runs ESLint, and executes the integration test suite in a Node container.

nodes.name: Build & Deploy to Dev
nodes.summary: Runs on push to main: lints and tests, publishes a semantic-release version, builds and pushes the Docker image to DockerHub, and bumps the development Kustomize overlay for GitOps deployment.

nodes.name: Promote to Production
nodes.summary: A manually dispatched workflow that promotes a given image tag to the production Kustomize overlay and commits the bump, gated to the Greenstand organization.

domainMeta.entryPoint: workflow_dispatch with a required git-tag input

nodes.name: Dispatch Route
nodes.summary: The Express router matches the image-resize GET URL and dispatches it to the handler, wrapped by the async error-handling wrapper.

nodes.name: Parse URL and Resize Params
nodes.summary: resizeImageArbitraryDepth parses the arbitrary-depth image URL and the h/w/r/q resize parameters from the request path.

nodes.name: Fetch Remote Image
nodes.summary: resizeImage downloads the source image from its URL over HTTP via axios before any transform.

nodes.name: Validate Resize Params
nodes.summary: Joi schemas validate the height, width, rotation, and quality parameters, failing fast on invalid input.

nodes.name: Apply Sharp Transforms
nodes.summary: Sharp chains resize, rotate, and jpeg transforms and produces the output buffer; the original buffer is returned when no params apply.

nodes.name: Stream Response
nodes.summary: The handler streams the resulting image buffer back to the client in the HTTP response.

nodes.name: Handle Errors
nodes.summary: The global error handler translates HttpError, Joi ValidationError, and Axios errors from the resize path into proper HTTP status codes and JSON bodies.

nodes.name: Dispatch Route
nodes.summary: The router matches GET /img/:domain/:image and dispatches it to resizeImageGet through the async wrapper.

nodes.name: Validate Request Params
nodes.summary: resizeImageGet validates the incoming image request parameters before delegating to the service.

nodes.name: Resize Image
nodes.summary: The handler delegates to ResizeImageService to fetch and transform the image.

nodes.name: Pipe Stream
nodes.summary: The resulting image stream is piped back into the HTTP response.

nodes.name: Load Environment Config
nodes.summary: server.js loads the per-environment dotenv file via .env.${NODE_ENV} before requiring the app.

nodes.name: Configure Logging
nodes.summary: setup.js sets the loglevel default from NODE_LOG_LEVEL, falling back to info.

nodes.name: Build Express App
nodes.summary: app.js constructs the Express application, wiring CORS, JSON parsing, the content-type guard, the router, and the global error handler.

nodes.name: Start Listening
nodes.summary: server.js starts the Express app listening on the configured port.

nodes.name: CORS and JSON Parsing
nodes.summary: The app applies CORS and JSON body parsing to the incoming request.

nodes.name: Content-Type Guard
nodes.summary: A guard middleware rejects non-JSON POST requests with HTTP 415.

nodes.name: Route Dispatch
nodes.summary: The API router matches the request URL and forwards it to the correct handler.

nodes.name: Async Error Wrapping
nodes.summary: handlerWrapper runs the async handler and forwards any rejected promise to next(), enabling throw-based error flow.

nodes.name: Global Error Handling
nodes.summary: errorHandler maps HttpError, Joi ValidationError, and Axios errors to status codes and JSON bodies, defaulting to 500.

nodes.name: Open Session
nodes.summary: Session wraps the shared Knex connection and begins a transaction for the operation.

nodes.name: Build Filtered Query
nodes.summary: BaseRepository translates nested and/or filter objects into chained Knex where clauses via a recursive whereBuilder.

nodes.name: Execute CRUD Operation
nodes.summary: BaseRepository runs getById, getByFilter, countByFilter, update, or create against the configured table.

nodes.name: Commit or Rollback
nodes.summary: Session commits on success or rolls back when an HttpError with shouldRollback() is raised.

nodes.name: Install Dependencies
nodes.summary: The PR workflow installs npm dependencies in a Node container.

nodes.name: Run ESLint
nodes.summary: The workflow runs ESLint to enforce code style on the pull request.

nodes.name: Run Integration Tests
nodes.summary: The workflow executes the Mocha/Supertest integration suite against the app.

nodes.name: Lint and Test
nodes.summary: The build-deploy-dev test job lints and runs integration tests before release.

nodes.name: Semantic Release Version
nodes.summary: The release job publishes a semantic-release version and updates the changelog.

nodes.name: Build and Push Docker Image
nodes.summary: The release job builds the node:16-alpine Docker image and pushes it to DockerHub.

nodes.name: Update Dev Overlay
nodes.summary: The release job bumps the container image tag in the development Kustomize overlay for GitOps deployment.

nodes.name: Dispatch with Tag
nodes.summary: The workflow is manually dispatched with a required git-tag input, gated to the Greenstand organization.

nodes.name: Update Production Overlay
nodes.summary: The workflow promotes the given image tag to the production Kustomize overlay.

nodes.name: Commit Bump
nodes.summary: The workflow commits the image tag bump to record the production promotion.

edges.description: The router and middleware chain dispatch HTTP image requests to the resize handlers and translate their errors into HTTP responses.
Repository failures raise HttpError with a rollback flag that the global error handler converts to HTTP responses.
The pipeline containerizes and deploys the running Express app that serves the request lifecycle.
